remarks: *BEST & FINAL by Tuesday 4/28 at 6pm sharp* Welcome to 16 Possum Lane, nestled in one of Norwalk's most special and serene neighborhoods, surrounded by mature trees and just moments from Rowayton Woods. This inviting home offers a versatile above-ground finished lower level-perfect as a cozy living room, home gym, Rec room, or even a potential in-law setup. Upstairs, the main level features three bedrooms, one and a half baths, a bright living room, and an eat-in kitchen that flows seamlessly into the dining area. Sliders lead out to a spacious deck, making indoor-outdoor entertaining effortless. Additional highlights include central air, a water filtration system, and access to sought-after Rowayton school district. Commuters will love the convenience of a quick trip to the Rowayton train station, with an easy 55-minute ride into NYC. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy comfort, flexibility, and location all in one!
